title: Unconscious person
summary: Check breathing first. Breathing decides what you do next.
doSteps: Call to them and tap their shoulders.
Tilt the head back gently and look, listen and feel for breathing for 10 seconds.
If they are breathing, roll them onto their side with the top leg bent.
If they are not breathing, call 112 and push hard and fast in the centre of the chest.
Keep checking their breathing until help arrives.
dontSteps: Do not give food or drink.
Do not leave them alone on their back.
Do not slap or splash water on them.
